# The Green Rooms

> Bespoke garden rooms, offices, gyms and golf simulator studios hand-built across Surrey and the South East. SIPs construction, 10-year guarantee, fully turnkey from ground screws to electrical sign-off.

The Green Rooms is a Surrey-based garden building company founded in 2019. We design and build bespoke garden rooms, garden offices, garden gyms, garden pods, golf simulator studios and bespoke structures for residential and commercial clients across Surrey, Berkshire, West London and the South East. Every build is fully turnkey — from ground screw foundations to plastered interior, flooring, electrics and final handover.

We use SIPs (Structural Insulated Panels) throughout every build — walls, floor and roof — giving superior thermal performance, strength and soundproofing compared to standard timber frame. All builds include a mains-connected consumer unit, full electrical test and signed electrical certificate. 150+ builds completed. 5-star rated on Google with 39 reviews.

Showroom open 7 days a week at The Farm Shop, Lyne Lane, Lyne, Surrey KT16 0AN.

## What We Build

- [Garden Pods](https://www.thegreenrooms.com/garden-rooms/garden-pods): Compact, entry-level garden buildings from £12,750 inc VAT. UPVC sliding doors, SIPs insulation, single pitch roof.
- [Garden Rooms](https://www.thegreenrooms.com/garden-rooms/garden-rooms): Versatile spaces for entertaining, relaxing or creating, from £16,950 inc VAT. Bifold doors, canopy and cladding options.
- [Garden Offices](https://www.thegreenrooms.com/garden-rooms/garden-offices): Purpose-built workspaces designed for year-round use, from £15,450 inc VAT. Triple glazing, hard-wired WiFi, climate control.
- [Garden Rooms with Storage](https://www.thegreenrooms.com/garden-rooms/garden-rooms-with-storage): Garden room with a concealed integrated storage room, from £18,900 inc VAT.
- [Golf Simulator Studios](https://www.thegreenrooms.com/garden-rooms/golf-simulator-studios): Extended-height studios with 3m+ internal height, from £37,500 inc VAT. Built in partnership with Golf Swing Systems.
- [Bespoke Garden Rooms](https://www.thegreenrooms.com/garden-rooms/bespoke): Fully custom structures — any shape, size or specification. Individually designed and quoted.
- [Garden Gyms](https://www.thegreenrooms.com/garden-rooms/garden-gym): Purpose-built gym spaces with rubber flooring, extended height options and full electrical fit-out.
- [Home Extensions](https://www.thegreenrooms.com/garden-rooms/home-extensions): Structurally connected home extensions from £60,000+.

## Your Build — How It Works

- [Structure & SIPs](https://www.thegreenrooms.com/your-build/structure): Why we use SIPs throughout and what it means for your build.
- [Foundations](https://www.thegreenrooms.com/your-build/foundations): Ground screw foundations — installed in hours, no excavation or concrete required.
- [Cladding Options](https://www.thegreenrooms.com/your-build/cladding-options): Western Red Cedar, charred spruce, Thermo Ayous, Hardie Plank, Millboard composite. Cedar and Thermo Ayous lifespan 30+ years; charred spruce 40+ years; Hardie Plank and Millboard 50+ years.
- [Windows & Doors](https://www.thegreenrooms.com/your-build/windows-and-doors): Aluminium bifold doors, sliding doors, French doors, Crittall-style doors. UPVC sliding doors on garden pods.
- [Roofing](https://www.thegreenrooms.com/your-build/roofing): EPDM or metal panel roofing — 20-year guarantee. Never felt.
- [Flooring](https://www.thegreenrooms.com/your-build/flooring): Laminate included as standard. Rubber gym matting available for gym builds.
- [Electrical & Lighting](https://www.thegreenrooms.com/your-build/electrical): Mains-connected consumer unit, recessed downlights, exterior lighting. Full test and signed electrical certificate included.
- [Climate Control](https://www.thegreenrooms.com/your-build/climate-control): Smart electric panel heaters as standard. Air conditioning available in 2.5kW, 3.5kW and 5kW — heats in winter, cools in summer.
- [Landscaping](https://www.thegreenrooms.com/your-build/landscaping): Porcelain paving, composite decking and landscaping via our trusted partner.

## Key Facts

- Founded: 2019
- Location: Lyne, Surrey (showroom and base)
- Area served: Surrey, Berkshire, West London, South East England
- Builds completed: 150+
- Google rating: 5.0 stars (39 reviews)
- Guarantee: 10-year structural guarantee
- Construction method: SIPs (Structural Insulated Panels) throughout — walls, roof and floor
- Foundations: Ground screws (no concrete, no excavation)
- Roofing: EPDM or metal panel (20-year guarantee, never felt)
- Flooring standard: Laminate fitted and included on all builds
- Interior finish standard: Plastered walls — painting not included as standard
- Electrics: Mains-connected consumer unit, full test, signed electrical certificate
- Planning: Can handle planning applications via specialist planning consultant
- Payment: Four-stage schedule — £500 booking deposit, 30% on day one, 30% at plastering, 40% on sign-off
- Build time: Typically 2–3 weeks on site
- Phone: 01932 640242
- Email: info@thegreenrooms.com
